title: TEHRAN – October 8, 2026 – Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran made remarks in an interview.
text:
TEHRAN – October 8, 2026 – Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran made remarks in an interview."

""
"SOT1, Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:28): "These threats of theirs are nothing new; they have been threatening for a lifetime and are even carrying out operations, and they haven't backed down. The people of Iran are resilient, and the country of Iran is resilient. Iran's programs, in accordance with IAEA safeguards and under NPT regulations, have no deviations. This uproar and the fear-mongering they are instigating actually show that they have reached a dead end and have nothing left to say.""

"SOT2, Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi) (00:29 - 01:19): "ٍٍEnrichment is an integral part of the nuclear process. Is it even possible for us not to have the starting point of the process and then claim that you have a nuclear industry? The nuclear industry is the driving engine of science and technology. The Americans themselves,  the current President himself, in his national development, national security, and national defense documents, has placed nuclear technology as a priority for development. All countries are accelerating their pursuit of nuclear capabilities. These are deceptions; these are lies. What is certain is the progress of a nation. The people of Iran, who are not a left-behind nation, but a first-rate and talented nation; the country of Iran is a country of great capacity. The right to progress to the frontier of knowledge is the right of the Iranian nation, and we will not back down.
